name: orbital-crash
description: Pure arcade survival — steer your star, annihilate opposite charge, survive the Anomalies.

scripts.build: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html bestiary.html manifest.webmanifest sw.js www/ && cp -R icons www/icons
